issues.title: Arm stage: render house floorplan scene + furniture obstacle mapping
issues.description: ArmEnvironment renders the bd-house-scenes-config floorplan: walls, doorway gaps, furniture boxes at catalog dims; map ONE designated furniture piece (per task) into scene.obstacleCenterMeters/HalfExtents so the kernel collision stays active; goal ring on the placement furniture. Reuse for all three tasks (kitchen = Craftsman kitchen corner, living-room = parlor, backyard = porch).

issues.title: Promote G1 flagship to source-bound whole-body walking
issues.description: Extend the current proven 15-DoF lower-body-and-waist flagship in place to the source-bound whole Unitree G1 only after the full catalog, inertias, joint limits, collision geometry, and controller interfaces have owner provenance. Preserve the existing SE(3), multibody, contact, friction, policy, and CMA owners; avoid a browser-side physics island.
issues.acceptance_criteria: Whole-body catalog provenance and symmetry tests; arm and upper-body dynamics participate in rollouts; stable upright reference lasts the full horizon; meaningful gait curriculum and fixed held-out replay; optimization beats the zero/reference baseline across multiple declared seeds without reward hacking; render consumes all owner poses; performance stays interactive in a worker with published browser measurements.

issues.title: Kernel: multi-obstacle scenes for house navigation
issues.description: fs-cmaes-viz-wasm scene struct carries ONE obstacle (obstacleCenterMeters/HalfExtents) + one goal. Extend to N oriented box obstacles (furniture) with the same conservative OBB collision used for the counter, so house navigation physics is honest: contact/penetration penalties per furniture piece. Owner: frankensim crate (sibling territory — coordinate; the schema-2 refusal envelope gates the packet change). Unblocks: honest G1 house navigation (bd-g1-house-nav), honest arm house physics.
